summary: Solid implementation; all ACs validated (3 proven live, AC3/AC5 via unit+code), all prior review feedback addressed, tsc + 45 unit tests green. One non-blocking test-coverage suggestion; approval is the human reviewer's call.

comments.body: suggestion — This outer `catch` path (when `perpsClosePositions` rejects/throws → FAILED status, `number_positions_closed: 0`, CLOSE_ALL_FAILED toast) has no unit coverage. The new failure tests in perps-view.test.tsx exercise only resolved `{ success: false, ... }` results, not a rejected promise. Adding a `mockRejectedValueOnce` case would close the remaining sibling gap to the partial/failed branches that were added in cc776be5.
